name: HatchGrab
subtitle: Food truck ordering system
promotionalText: Take pre-orders, protect the kitchen from excessive orders and keep serving when the signal drops. Ordering app for food truck staff.
description:
HatchGrab is the ordering and kitchen app for food trucks: the tool your team runs service with.

Customers order in advance and choose a collection time. Your staff see all orders on one screen, confirm whatever the kitchen can cook and then mark them as ready and as collected.

NEVER PROMISE A TIME YOU CAN'T KEEP
Set how much your kitchen can cook at the same time and how long it needs. When a collection time fills up, customers can't choose it, so the queue matches the kitchen.

ON-THE-SPOT ORDERS
Add on-the-spot orders on the same screen as orders placed in advance, so the kitchen works from one queue.

ONE SCREEN FOR THE KITCHEN
The kitchen screen shows what needs to be made now, what follows and what is ready, with an alert when an order needs to start.

ORDER TICKET PRINTING
Connect a kitchen receipt printer via Bluetooth or via your local network, and order tickets print automatically.

KEEP SERVING WHEN THE SIGNAL DROPS
Switch on offline protection and, if the connection is lost, advance orders are paused, so nobody places an order you won't see. Orders you enter on the device are kept and sync when you reconnect.

MADE FOR THE FOOD TRUCK
Use it on iPhone or iPad. Keep the screen on during service, get a notification when an order needs confirmation, and lock the app with Face ID or Touch ID.

ORGANISE YOUR WEEK
Set up your events and locations once and take orders for each one.

HatchGrab is for people who run food trucks and their staff. You need a HatchGrab account to sign in.
whatsNew:
